More CLAP goodness before the world blows up lol.

###############################################################################################
Another quality release from your friends at the Cream Lemon Archival Project!

This time we're releasing Ami III (episode 13), the third installment in Ami series. Unfortunately, the only known uncensored source for this episode is a degraded 2nd gen VHS copy of the original Brazilian version known as "Hellcats". For that reason, extra work was put to clean up and make sure the uncensored shots blend properly with the higher quality LD version. While still not optimal, it should be good enough for a first version. More coming next month!

Want to help restore the footage, provide new sources for us to use and restore, or work on the scripts? Join our Discord server!

**Video sources:** Japanese LD (WMV), Uncensored Brazilian “Sonhos Molhados” VHS (Hellcats)
**Audio sources:** Japanese LD (DVDISO)
